notes.title: Occlude Update 1.0.2 & Announcing the Cardinals Update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]Hello fellow cultists, occultists and related adherents. A double edition Steam post for you - Updating Occlude to 1.0.3 and announcing a major, free update coming in a couple of months![/p][p][/p][h1]Salutations, Update 1.0.3[/h1][p]This update resolves the last of our outstanding game issues from launch. It includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fixes to typos across the board.[/b] Especially annoying was the misspelling of Tributary, our own company, in the credits. Woops.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanding Game Rules[/b]. Players rightly pointed out that they didn't include wording around Purgatory Slots, and we noticed some confusion with how Undo worked in Classic Mode. We've updated both in the Game Rules.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ongoing controller support[/b]. We know a small number of players on certain devices have had issues with using controllers. We've made some changes to help this. [/p][list][*][p]We could do with some concrete reproduction steps before we can confidently say "it's fixed" so do let us know in the Discussions or comments if you have a recurring issue with using controllers. Do let us know exactly what happened before/after, with what controller setup you were using.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]General bug fixes and stability updates.[/p][/*][/list][p]We now feel confident enough to move onto adding more content to Occlude. Which reminds me...[/p][p][/p][h1]Introducing the Cardinals Update[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/60ebf6b40e9693dde3770bb595eb4ebc3fe7e79a.png"][/img][/p][p]We're extremely excited to announce a [b]major, free update to Occlude[/b] in the Cardinals Update![/p][p]We will be adding over 20 new puzzles to the game, each a variant of one of the seven Rituals, called [b]Cardinals[/b].[/p][p]The rules of each Cardinal will be a new challenge for players, while also being loosely based off their original Ritual. Completing all Cardinals will unlock a new Archive Object and Document for those lore hunters out there.[/p][p]We know fans of Occlude wanted even more puzzles to chew on and we're extremely happy to oblige by more than doubling the amount of puzzles in-game.[/p][p]Currently we're figuring out when this will be ready for you lot to play (as players of Occlude know, timelines are fiddly things to get right). All we can say now is that we're looking at couple of months until they're ready - Please bear with us![/p][p]This update will also come with a number of Quality of Life updates that people have requested which take more time than a smaller update.[/p][p]Let us know what you think in the comments below. Don't forget to hop on our Discord to meet other Obscurants and read our lore drops - There's a new one out today![/p][p]Happy hunting,[/p][p]S[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/e172fc2ef9db92b2f561d9a84339845d37d622de.jpg"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]P.S. - We're trying to get out Trading Cards and Badges out for the game, but Steam keeps rejecting us for fairly vague reasons. Which is fun and fine! After the fourth round of trying to submit these, they hopefully will be with you this week. Apologies for the wait.[/p]

notes.title: Occlude Update 1.0.2
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]We just can't help ourself - Our second update to Occlude is out! [/p][p]This is another small-ish one, addressing a few missing assets and further improving our controller support.[/p][p]As we said in our previous post the outpouring of support and love for Occlude has been humbling. As has huge amount of feedback![/p][p]We're working our way through your thoughts and comments as we speak, but in the meantime let's dig into what's inside 1.0.2.[/p][p][/p][h1]Welcome, Update 1.0.2[/h1][p]This update has focused on two things - Updating artwork and further improving controller support:[/p][list][*][p][b]Improved Game Rules[/b]. The Game Rules (accessible through the options menu) had images that were thoroughly out of date and the text misleading in more than one place.[/p][list][*][p]All images have been updated and text revisited to make the game clearer for players. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Updated controller support[/b]. Players using Steam Deck and controllers couldn't reach unlocked endings and a few other key parts of the game.[/p][list][*][p]We've corrected this, making sure players can navigate all areas with the controller and done a few tweaks to the controller system.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Update King of Spades art.[/b] He was missing his lower K - Some players thought this was a secret clue and went mildly wild trying to figure out what this intentional error meant.[/p][list][*][p]Sorry to say, it wasn't intentional. As of this update, the King is no longer missing his K.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We've also corrected a few other minor bugs reported.[/p][/*][/list][p]Our next step is currently looking to reviewing save files and improving readability and accessibility. This may take a little longer, so we thought we'd get this easier update out of the way first.[/p][p]Also - We have got Steam Trading Cards and Badges in review. Just waiting on Steam to review and they'll be dropping![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for the outpouring of love. If you haven't yet, go check out the Tributary Games discord, where you will find fellow players, wild theories, lore drops and even a smattering of fan art![/p][p]See you soon.[/p][p]S[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/a2eca57d62952a79a1dd23e7addfdaf645a723ee.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Occlude Update 1.0.1
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]Hello Obscurants, Magicians and other practitioners.[/p][p]First we wanted to thank you from the bottom our hearts for the response to Occlude at launch. [/p][p]Over 5,000 of you have walked through the door in the rain and we're currently sitting on 86% (!!!) "Very Positive" reviews.[/p][p]We're a tiny team who have worked extremely hard to make Occlude, but it's all been worth it for the reaction at launch. [/p][p]You honestly don't know how much it means to us. Thank you again.[/p][p]Right, enough of the soppy stuff, onto the meat of this post:[/p][p][/p][h1]Introducing Update 1.0.1[/h1][p]Over launch we spotted a few bugs and issues players were having. [/p][p]We jumped straight on this after going live and are pleased to announce Occlude 1.0.1 - A small update to the launch build.[/p][p]This contains:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fixes for Steam Deck players[/b], specifically with moving off the bottom of the Foundations and accidentally hitting "New Deal". [/p][list][*][p]Now when you navigate down from the bottom Foundation (Spades) you return to the top Foundation (Clubs). [/p][/*][*][p]Furthermore, if you navigate up from the top Foundation (Clubs) you instead go to "Undo" rather than "New Deal".[/p][/*][*][p]The next change will also help our Steam Deck players with this issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Also - Steam Deck players - Our Deck setup is very much in Beta! We also have a recommended controller layout uploaded to the workshop. Let us know what you think of these changes and how the game works on Deck in the Discussions section.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Confirmation popups for New Deal and Exit[/b]. On hitting either of these buttons, these small popups show underneath the existing buttons with confirmation buttons.[/p][list][*][p]We've also reworded "Quit" to become "Exit", and this popup explains better than the game will save and then return you to the table, rather than quit the game.[/p][/*][*][p]For long time players this might take a little getting used to, but it was highly requested and we couldn't have so many players losing progress.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fixes for clearing saves and playing Tutorials again[/b]. Previously doing this would occasionally give you a board that wasn't possible to complete while following the tutorials.[/p][list][*][p]We were made aware of this issue shortly before launch but this took a little bit of delicate work to get right. [/p][/*][*][p]Now you can clear saves and replay the tutorial to your heart's content.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fix for the final unlock and Credits showing up twice[/b]. Players who finished the game and then played another Ritual would get the Photograph Object popping up again and Credits roll for a second time - Now, no more.[/p][list][*][p]The Credits will now also not show if you've completed the game in Story Mode only - Instead, a screen encouraging players to give Classic Mode a spin will appear.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We've also corrected a few typos, updated some wording and squashed minor visual bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p]Despite our sturdy build on launch, there's always something that slips through, so we were keen to get these issues responded to as quickly as possible. [/p][p]We're going back to the Occlude mines for more work, which we'll post about soon. [/p][p]If you've spotted an issue let us know in the Discussions! We'd love to help.[/p][p][/p][p]Again, thank you all so much for your support. Also, if you enjoyed Occlude and haven't reviewed the game yet, please do consider it![/p][p]Each review is like recommending the game to five other people in the eyes of the Steam algorithm. [/p][p]We love to read them and appreciate each one massively. No worries if not! We'll see you at the table, either way.[/p][p]Until next time.[/p][p]S[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/a2eca57d62952a79a1dd23e7addfdaf645a723ee.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Demo update - Fixing 'sticky' cards and dates
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]Greetings Obscurants! A THIRD update has gone out to the Occlude Demo, which is now on version 0.2.6.[/p][p]This includes:[/p][list][*][p]A fix to stop cards sticking to the player's mouse[/p][/*][*][p]A fix to say that the Demo is not, in fact, from the future, but 2025. The present year. Which is now.[/p][/*][/list][p][u]Make sure you update the Demo to get these changes.[/u] This now brings us up to three Updates in under a week (help me) and joins the following:[/p][list][*][p]An Undo button for any move before committing a card to a Foundation[/p][/*][*][p]Animations to notify players if they need to Undo or Redeal[/p][/*][*][p]Increased speed of cards following the mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Double click to instantly send a card to the Foundation, right click to Mark[/p][/*][*][p]Tableau piles now resizing, so cards don't stack off-screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for Continue/reloading games[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for a bug with clearing saves[/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3547010/view/570381806642135271?l=english"]As we spoke about in our other, longer blog post[/url], we're now working on the following Launch features based off community feedback:[/p][list][*][p]An optional Story Mode that gives you an unlimited Undo, extra Purgatory slots and easier seeds to play with[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the seed generation system across the board, aimed to make sure you can sort the deck without having to place a Final Card early[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tutorialisation[/p][/*][*][p]More information on past runs, including past coins earned[/p][/*][*][p]More meta-narrative and more rituals (these were planned, but people have asked for them!)[/p][/*][/list][p]This will likely be our final Demo update as the above is taking up 90% of our time.[/p][p]Now, a personal request - We've worked really, really hard on the Demo to date, then to sift through hundreds of feedback points, to then make these changes carefully and quickly.[/p][p]If you like game studios who are dedicated to their craft, why not wishlist Occlude? [/p][p]It's going to be [i]even better[/i] on launch thanks to this Demo and we could do with the help against the dreaded Steam algorithm, who is currently absolutely uninterested in showing Occlude to, well, anyone.[/p][p]Thanks again - We'll talk soon![/p][p]Sam[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Demo update - Undo/Redeal Hints, Card improvements and plans for difficulty.
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to our second update post. If you haven't guessed, we're committed to making Occlude absolutely fantastic for everyone. [/p][p]I hope we've shown this by doing two updates in four days alone![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3547010/view/505078875556941499?l=english"]You can read about the changes we made in the first 24 hours to the demo here.[/url][/p][p]If you're a fan of studios who listen to feedback and games with this level of love in them, please [b]consider wishlisting the game[/b]. [/p][p]Each wishlist boosts us in the Steam algorithm and helps us reach an audience on an increasingly crowded Steam.[/p][p]Our second update brings more highly requested changes to the Occlude demo. Lower down you can read what we're changing for launch based off your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h2]Demo Update 2 Changes[/h2][h3]Undo/Redeal Hints[/h3][p]Players have been requesting help for when their game gets 'locked' - Either when they need to undo a move or can't make any more moves.[/p][p]For both of these cases [b]the Redeal and Undo buttons will now animate[/b]. We hope this removes the frustration some have felt not knowing if they can advance or not![/p][p]Players have also requested a wider Hint system which may take more time. We'd like to see if this change helps before committing to a kind of larger, more design fiddly change such as that. [/p][p]We're a small team, working on an even smaller amount of time, so we sadly have to pick our battles.[/p][p][/p][h3]Snappier Cards, easier movement[/h3][p]A number of players find that moving cards is sluggish and difficult. [/p][p]So, we've [b]sped up the movement of cards when being dragged[/b]. Fling those cards around and please do tell us how it feels![/p][p]This was a great first step, but we [i]also[/i] got feedback that shifting cards to the Foundation was laborious. No more - [b]You[/b] [b]can now double click to send a card straight to the Foundation[/b]. [/p][p]This has meant we've swapped marking cards to a right-click. We know this many make one Ritual marginally harder, so let us know if you like/dislike this change.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cards coming off screen[/h3][p]Players found that with extra big Tableau piles, cards were wandering off the screen and became unclickable. [/p][p]Like we said in the last post, we had a fix in mind for this, and now as of today [b]Tableau piles will resize when lots of cards are placed on them[/b].[/p][p]This works for all game resolutions and is weirdly really fun to do.[/p][p][/p][h3]Wrong Rituals fixed[/h3][p]A bug we started to track after posting our last update was players continuing or loading back into games to find they are playing a different Ritual.[/p][p]This was actually a fun bug - The players weren't actually playing different Rituals, just the asset for the Ritual Card wasn't updating properly. Joy.[/p][p]This update fixes this, so now [b]you won't see the wrong Ritual Card when returning to a game[/b].[/p][p]There were a few other places this was occurring that weren't reported we also fixed, because we're nice like that.[/p][p][/p][h2]Launch changes based on feedback[/h2][p]This responds to 3 of the 5 major bits of feedback we mentioned in the last update. The other 2, plus the many suggestions, ideas and input we've received, are going to take a bit longer to respond to.[/p][p]Some have forced us to redesign the game and do so very carefully, but we're confident these changes make Occlude better for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3]"Casual Mode"[/h3][p]Though a lot of feedback liked the current difficulty, many felt it was too punishing. [/p][p]Many more specifically asked for a casual mode and we're now working on this.[/p][p]Our current thinking is that this would have an unlimited undo and two purgatory slots, as well as its own set of seeds that are easier to complete. [/p][p]Naming to be confirmed, as "casual" sounds a little derogatory for our liking.[/p][p]We also realized that lots of players simply didn't expect the 'Occlude Experience' - A tricky game of Solitaire where Redealing is encouraged and failure expected. That's on us. [/p][p]We're look at messaging to make it abundantly clear to players what the game is about, while pointing to this "casual" mode as an option they may be interested in.[/p][p]By doing this, we don't affect the many players who like the current challenge of Occlude, who still get the difficulty and chewy version that's closer to this demo.[/p][p][/p][h3]RNG Difficulty/Balance[/h3][p]For both modes of Occlude we're generating new seeds to go into the game using a much altered seed generation system.[/p][p]These new seeds will be solve-able for all combinations of Final Cards. Our original thinking was that players wouldn't mind an occasional Redeal, but feedback has shown quite the opposite. [/p][p]These will also allow for simpler first moves so you can get a game started faster.[/p][p]For non-"casual" mode the seeds will be slightly easier than the demo but still tough, and for "casual" mode these will be considerably easier all round.[/p][p]We're also looking at detecting when players are struggling and throw them a bone with an easier seed.[/p][p]This is a massive undertaking and has taken us away from the many other features we want to add to Occlude, but we're confident it'll improve the game for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3]Tutorialisation[/h3][p]Our current very basic Tutorial is not cutting the mustard! Feedback was really clear about that.[/p][p]We're allocating time to work on a more in-depth Tutorial that will guide players through the start of a game better.[/p][p]Tutorials are generally awful to make in games, so how extensive this will be down to how much time we get for it. Tiny team, tiny budget, tiny amount of time.[/p][p][/p][h3]Review screen[/h3][p]You want somewhere to see how many Coins you've earned, a few stats and even revisit old narrative that showed up? Sure thing![/p][p]We had planned this for launch, but your feedback has made us change how this will look - You clearly want lots of information about your runs and we want to give it to you.[/p][p][/p][h3]Meta-Narrative/More Rituals[/h3][p]Players want both more of a meta-narrative to the game and more Rituals to complete. [/p][p]That's a nice and easy bit of feedback to answer - We have both, but you'll have to wait for the full game to see it.[/p][p][/p][h2]Happy? Wishlist us![/h2][p]Thank you all again for your feedback. [/p][p]I can't lie, it's been tough read in places, but most of you have been wonderfully polite and understanding about the difficulties of indie game development.[/p][p]That feedback has made [u]Occlude fundamentally better[/u] - Better than when we first released the demo and better for launch. [/p][p]We now have a clear path to follow when Occlude hits your Store page on the [b]10th of July[/b].[/p][p]If you appreciate what we're doing, go wishlist Occlude. Like I said above, it helps us more than you can imagine.[/p][p]I'll keep up the updates and let you know how your feedback shaped the game.[/p][p]Thanks again,[/p][p]Sam[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Demo update - Undo button, clear save fixes and your feedback so far.
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif"][/img][/p][p]We've had a ton of feedback on our new Occlude Demo for NextFest. Plenty positive, a few negative, and the vast majority asking for one feature above all - An Undo button.[/p][p][/p][h2]Undo Button[/h2][p]Partly because we had a great deal of early feedback saying the difficulty was "just right" and partly for Secret Reasons that'll become obvious when you play the final game, an Undo mechanic was something we were planning for after the NextFest Demo.[/p][p]However it's become abundantly clear from feedback the Undo is absolutely necessary and necessary right now. So, your past mistakes can now be undone - We've worked at breakneck speed overnight [b]to bring you an Undo button[/b].[/p][p]For those of you concerned this will make the game trivial, do not worry - This won't let you undo [i]everything[/i].[/p][p]You can now undo moves up to the point you put a card in the Foundation. What this means is, if you accidentally lock yourself by moving cards around the Tableau (a common complaint), you don't have to reshuffle with a New Deal every time.[/p][p]Make sure you update the Demo to get this change and let us know what you think.[/p][p][/p][h2]Clearing Save Files[/h2][p]We've also had feedback saying that clearing game saves have had a few issues, including odd animations and game softlocks. We've identified this problem and pushed up that change to the demo with the Undo button update.[/p][p]If you're playing on old branches from playtesting and wanted to clear your saves manually, don't forget you can copy paste [u]%USERPROFILE%\\\\AppData\\\\LocalLow\\\\Tributary Games\\\\Occlude\\\\Saves[/u] into your File Explorer to delete SAVEFILE.save in there.[/p][p][/p][h2]Feedback: Next Steps[/h2][p]We're not stopping there, of course. As a studio we pride ourselves on listening to our player's feedback and making changes based off of them.[/p][p]We're looking at five major bits of feedback we've had in the first 24 hours:[/p][list][*][p][b]RNG difficulty/balance[/b] - We're hearing that the shuffle of cards in a new game is causing headaches for players. Essentially - [b]You feel like the difficulty is too high[/b]. We're looking at our generation system to get you into the flow of Occlude quicker while keeping the challenge for those of you who enjoy the current level of difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Locked game indicator[/b] - You're asking for better feedback when a game can't be advanced, so we're taking a look at making the Undo and Reshuffle buttons animate, depending on game state, to make it clearer when you need to use them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speed/'snappiness' of cards[/b] - People are finding card movement too sluggish. That's a nice straightforward fix which we can get on straight away.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cards coming off screen[/b] - We're aware that with certain resolutions sizes larger stacks of cards are coming off the screen. We have a fix for this we're working on right now.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Casual Mode[/b] - Lots of players are asking for a casual mode. This one is difficult - We're a small team and this would mean we'd have to build a whole other game mode in a short time, taking us away from vital other work. We're looking at our backlog of jobs to do and figuring out what can be done in the time and budget we have. No promises, I'm sorry to say, but we have some ideas how we can help.[/p][/*][/list][p]There is, of course, more feedback than this - But we've determined these are our top targets from the first 24 hours.[/p][p]If your feedback isn't above [u]we've still recorded it[/u] and endeavor to answer it in time.[/p][p][/p][h2]And finally...[/h2][p]Thank you all so, so much for the feedback.[/p][p]Making games, especially at the size we are, isn't easy and we don't always get it right the first time. We're sadly only human. However, with your feedback, we can make Occlude something really special.[/p][p]Please be patient while we do this![/p][p]I'm super happy we got this change out in under 24 hours, but making a game is anything but easy and we have to balance finishing the game with feedback changes. It's a balance we don't always get right, but one we're committed to doing so.[/p][p]So go update the Demo, give it a spin, tell us what you think, and we'll keep on hammering away at code in the background. Expect some more updates soon.[/p][p]Sam[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Seven Cards. Seven Entities.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/44a8a20fd3dcfb28b903b58f0b182eedd4b3b879.gif[/img]

This is not Solitaire. Or at least not as you know it.

It's a [b]ritual[/b] - or so testimonies from the unresolved case files say - passed down from generation to generation, played in isolation in back-rooms and forgotten spaces. 

We understand the framework - the ways in which a player might interact with the "game" - but we don't understand much more than that; what happens after. The pacts that seem to be made. The rules that govern them.  

Today the investigation into [b]Occlude[/b] must begin in earnest; its secrets documented, the anomalies in its design studied. [b]The case is now open[/b], if you can find the Investigation Board... 

[h1]Seven Cards. Seven Entities.[/h1]

The case is now open, but don't expect everything all at once. Investigations like this take time, and will take us right up until release.  

There are seven entities, we believe.  

And we've been offered seven cards. A coincidence?  

But they are not given up so easily - they require an offering; a word that connects their physical manifestation in this realm, to their abstract meaning in another.  

Find the [b]Table[/b] and the [b]Investigation Board[/b]. The evidence found so far has been password protected. Today is just the beginning. 

[url=https://www.gutenberg.org/files/21642/21642-h/21642-h.htm?utm_source=chatgpt.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/3906807d8ff37a9e3bd143bffe91b12c2a64d39b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]The door in the rain[/h1]

Did you open the door in the rain already? It is not locked. There is still time. This is not required to begin your investigation, but it's nice to have everything in one place.   

[url=https://www.pantaloon.io/join-us-at-the-table][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/bb932691b3584f3c57d960047f7579ab317f08e1.png[/img][/url]

Seek the four. Unite the suits.

For now we conclude, then. But there is more to come.  

The world 

is a broken machine. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585560/d525375d74874ee6951e7d7d5f427047a1c94f5a.gif[/img]
